description: Phase 3 Group B (UI Components Track) — ChatWindow and ChatInput client components. Touches ONLY src/components/ChatWindow.tsx and src/components/ChatInput.tsx. Runs in parallel with Group A (route handler track). Base branch: ralph/phase-2-project-management.

userStories.title: Build ChatWindow and ChatInput client components with streaming state
userStories.description: As a student, I need to see the agent's response stream into the chat window word-by-word and have the input disabled while it streams, so the chat feels live and prevents double-sends.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/components/ChatWindow.tsx` as a Client Component (`'use client'`)
ChatWindow accepts props: `projectId: string` and `initialMessages: { id: string; role: string; content: string }[]`
ChatWindow hydrates local state with `initialMessages` on mount
Path A: use `useChat` hook from `ai/react` with `api: /api/chat/${projectId}` — handle streaming state via hook's `isLoading` flag
Path B fallback: manage streaming manually with `useState` for messages and `isStreaming`, use `fetch` + `reader.read()` loop to append tokens to the last message in real time
Messages render in a scrollable container; each message shows role label ('You' for user, 'Trend Mapper' for model/assistant) and content as plain text (markdown rendering comes in Phase 4)
Auto-scroll to the bottom when new tokens arrive (use `useEffect` + `ref.scrollIntoView()` on the message list)
Create `src/components/ChatInput.tsx` as a Client Component (`'use client'`) with a `<textarea>` and 'Send' button
ChatInput accepts `onSubmit: (message: string) => void` and `disabled: boolean` props
Input and button are disabled when `disabled` is true; button label changes to 'Thinking...' during active stream
Submit on Enter key (without Shift) as well as button click
ChatInput clears after submit; empty or whitespace-only messages are not submitted
userStories.notes: These components work independently of the route implementation — they POST to /api/chat/[projectId] which will exist after Phase 3 Group A merges. Path A uses `useChat` from `ai/react`. Path B requires manual fetch + ReadableStream reader loop. Disabled state must be visually distinct (Tailwind opacity/cursor classes). These components are intentionally minimal — markdown rendering and loading indicators are Phase 4 work.
